reason: Conversation 1 reached the correct diagnosis: it identified dE as a door error, asked about load and seal, had the homeowner test with towels (which started fine), and confirmed the king-size duvet was preventing the latch engaging with no part needed. Its first reply misread the opener as a door-won't-open problem and the imbalance explanation was a bit wobbly, but it self-corrected and gave sensible advice. Conversation 2 asked reasonable door-focused questions but, when the homeowner volunteered the decisive clue (duvet bulging, corner in the seal), it ignored it, declared the cause unconfirmed, and needlessly escalated to an engineer for what was simply an overfilled drum.
